info.name: CoinGecko Crypto Market Data Asset Platforms Pools API
Get pool data by contract address

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

params.name: address
params.description: The pool contract address

params.name: include
params.description: Additional data to include (e.g., base_token, quote_token, dex)

items.docs: Get detailed data for a specific liquidity pool by its contract address on a given network. Includes price, volume, liquidity, and token information.

params.name: network
params.description: The blockchain network identifier (e.g., eth, bsc, polygon_pos, solana, arbitrum, avalanche, base)

params.name: addresses
params.description: Comma-separated list of pool contract addresses (up to 30)

params.name: include
params.description: Additional data to include (e.g., base_token, quote_token, dex)

items.docs: Get data for multiple liquidity pools in a single request by providing a comma-separated list of pool contract addresses on a specific network.
